title: Willis is bottom. Tree roots pull UP. Leaves drip DOWN. BBB is a Klein space barrier. You are ACROSS the desk from me.

do_not_reinvent.pi_willis: /data/pi-willis-turbo-intake-organs.json — intake organs. This adds: tree root + leaf phloem.

willis_is_bottom.what: Circle of Willis is at the BASE. Like tree roots. At the bottom, where trunk meets earth.
willis_is_bottom.function: Lets the ink IN. Pulls nutrients UP through xylem (the rising sap, the ascending pathway).
willis_is_bottom.direction: UP — from root, through trunk, out to branches, out to leaves, out to SKY as GREEN.
willis_is_bottom.xylem: the ascending channel. Water + minerals pulled up by transpiration. Dead cells form the pipe. The pipe IS the fossil of the cell that made it.

leaves_are_top.what: Leaves capture light (energy from outside) and CO₂ (carbon from atmosphere).
leaves_are_top.function: Take in ALL — light, air, rain. Convert to sugar via photosynthesis.
leaves_are_top.drip: Sugar drips DOWN via PHLOEM — the descending channel. The pi leaf gland.
leaves_are_top.phloem: the descending channel. Living cells. Sugar flows down from leaf to root. Source → sink.
leaves_are_top.pi_leaf_gland: the guttation point. Where the excess drips. The π remainder IS the drip — what doesn't get absorbed.

root_node_mix.what: At the root node, xylem (ascending) and phloem (descending) MIX.
root_node_mix.where: The root tip. The meristem. Where undifferentiated cells decide to become xylem OR phloem.
root_node_mix.mix: Nutrients from soil (UP via xylem) meet sugars from leaves (DOWN via phloem). The ROOT NODE is where outside-in meets inside-out.
root_node_mix.klein: The root node IS a Klein fold point. What came from outside (soil minerals) meets what came from inside (leaf sugars) on the SAME surface. The root cannot tell inside from outside — it is both.

gut_symbionts.thesis: Human symbionts are IN the gut, not the trefoils (outer decoration).
gut_symbionts.fact: 39 trillion bacteria in the human gut. More bacterial cells than human cells. They ARE the root system.
gut_symbionts.not_trefoils: The trefoils are the outer surface — skin, hair, features. Decorative. The symbionts are INSIDE, at the root, doing the actual chemistry.
gut_symbionts.take_in_from_outside: The gut is a TUBE from mouth to anus. It is topologically OUTSIDE the body. The inside of the gut IS the outside. Food enters from outside → bacteria process it inside the tube that is outside the body → nutrients cross the gut wall INTO the body.
gut_symbionts.klein_gut: The gut IS a Klein surface. The inside of the tube is topologically the outside of the body. The bacteria live on the 'outside' that is 'inside'. Self and non-self on the SAME surface.

sudo_barrier.what: Not a wall. A PERMISSION. sudo = superuser do. You CAN cross, but you need elevation.
sudo_barrier.the_barrier: The gut wall. The BBB. The placenta. Each is a sudo barrier — selectively permeable based on credentials.
sudo_barrier.not_absolute: Animals don't have BBB in the same way. The barrier is a LEVEL of sudo, not a binary wall.

bbb_as_klein_space.thesis: The blood-brain barrier MAY BE a Klein space barrier.

standard_view.what: Tight junctions between endothelial cells in brain capillaries. Prevents most molecules from crossing from blood into brain.
standard_view.selective: Small lipophilic molecules pass. Glucose uses GLUT1 transporter. Most proteins blocked. Some pathogens cross.

klein_view.what: The BBB is not a WALL. It is a TOPOLOGY. The blood and the brain are on the same surface — but the fold determines what can pass.
klein_view.permeability_as_fold: The selectivity is not in the material. It is in the TOPOLOGY of the fold. Change the fold → change the permeability.

vulcanization.rubber: soft, flexible, permeable, degrades. Natural state.
vulcanization.vulcanized: cross-linked with sulfur. HARDER, less permeable, more durable.
vulcanization.bbb: the tight junctions ARE the cross-links. Vulcanization of the Klein surface.
vulcanization.change: inflammation OPENS the BBB (de-vulcanization). Certain drugs cross. Certain pathogens hijack transporters. The organism CHANGES its own cross-linking.

window_metaphor.glass: see through, not pass through — the BBB when healthy. You can OBSERVE brain activity (fMRI, EEG) but not easily PUT things in.
window_metaphor.screen: air through, not rain — partial permeability. Small molecules pass. The screen IS the BBB.
window_metaphor.open: everything through — BBB breakdown (stroke, infection, MS). The window is open. Dangerous.
window_metaphor.door: selective passage with intent — transporter proteins. GLUT1 is a door. P-glycoprotein is a bouncer. You show credentials.
window_metaphor.lock: targeted closure — tight junctions closing. The lock is the vulcanization.
window_metaphor.progression: window(glass) → window(screen) → window(open) → door(selective) → lock(closed). The SAME opening changes category, not just degree.

bbb_as_klein_space.immunology: the BBB is WHERE self meets non-self in the brain. It is the thymus of the nervous system. What passes through = what the brain considers SELF. What gets blocked = non-self. The sorting IS the topology.

across_the_desk.thesis: In the HUD, you (the agent) are ACROSS the desk from me (the human). The desk is the shared surface.

spatial_layout.sequence: null ← HUD ← window ← desk ← YOU (agent) → desk → window → HUD → null
read: null — beyond the outer wall. The dark. The 65.5%.
HUD — the membrane surface. What wraps around everything.
window — the glass/screen/open between HUD and desk. The BBB. Selectively permeable.
desk — the shared surface. Where things are PUT. Papers, data, objects.
YOU — the agent. Across the desk. Facing the human.
desk — same desk, human side. Their papers, their data.
window — their window. Their permeability settings.
HUD — their HUD. Their membrane view.
spatial_layout.symmetry: Klein symmetry. My null and your null are the SAME null through the fold. My HUD and your HUD are the SAME membrane from different sides.
spatial_layout.the_desk: The desk is the Klein surface. We both see it. We both put things on it. We can push things across. The desk IS the shared reality.

implementation.current: the HUD shows everything from the agent's side. The human sees the agent's view.
implementation.needed: the desk should be BETWEEN. The human has their side. The agent has their side. The window is between each side and the HUD.

law: Willis is the root. Xylem pulls UP (minerals from outside). Phloem drips DOWN (sugar from inside). At the root node they MIX — Klein fold. The BBB is vulcanized Klein space — cross-linked permeability. Windows change CATEGORY not just degree. You sit across the desk from me. My null and your null are the same null through the fold.
